description.value: Siam Le Bien is an authentic Thai restaurant and bar established in 2023 on Burnaby's Hastings Street, named for Siam (the former name of Thailand) and the French word for 'good.' The kitchen emphasizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and a defining balance of sweetness, sourness, saltiness, spiciness, and umami across a wide menu of classic Thai dishes. Touring cyclists can dine in or order takeout via Uber Eats and DoorDash.
